Prep time: 15 minutes Cook time: 30 minutes Total time: 45 minutes Number of Servings: 7 Ingredients 3/4 pound lean ground beef 1/4teaspoon ground ginger 3/4 teaspoon garlic powder 2 Tablespoons packed brown sugar 1/4 cup low-sodium soy sauce 2 teaspoons cornstarch 1 Tablespoon sesame oil 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes 1/2 cup water 4 cups chopped broccoli (fresh or frozen) 3 cups cooked bulgur Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Cook beef, ginger and garlic powder in a skillet over medium-high heat (325 °F in an electric skillet) until meat is browned. In a medium bowl, mix sugar, soy sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, pepper flakes and water. Add sauce to beef and cook for 5 minutes. Add broccoli and cook until tender. Serve over cooked bulgur. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Try baked tofu instead of beef.
